item.title: A Starz Streaming Subscription Is Under $1 for a Limited Time: Claim the Deal Here
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Hey there, streaming fans! Are you looking for a great deal on a top-notch streaming service? Well, we've got some exciting news for you. Right now, you can score a rare deal on Starz, one of our favorite streaming services, for under $1."
[Short music transition]
Host: "That's right, new subscribers can get two months of access to Starz for just $0.99 a month. This is the cheapest streaming deal we've ever seen for Starz, saving you a whopping 92% on a monthly subscription. Normally, Starz costs $11.99 a month, but with this promo, you'll get access to the entire Starz library, including buzzy shows like Outlander, Power Book III: Raising Kanan, and 50 Cent's BMF."
[Short music transition]
Host: "To take advantage of this deal, head over to Amazon and log in with your Prime details. Navigate to the Starz hub and claim your 99-cents streaming offer. No promo code is needed, and you'll keep the price for your first two months. After that, you can choose to continue with the regular monthly price or cancel anytime."
[Short music transition]
Host: "And if you're not a Prime member, don't worry. You can sign up for a free 30-day trial and use it to get the Starz deal. Plus, with a Prime membership, you'll get access to the entire Prime Video library, including exclusive and original TV shows and movies, as well as other benefits like free one-day shipping and Prime Reading."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Now, we know what you're thinking - what if I don't want to pay for Starz at all? Well, you can actually watch Starz online for free through DirecTV Stream and Fubo, both of which offer free trials that include a live feed of Starz. Just keep in mind that these are live TV streamers, so you'll only be able to livestream Starz content, not watch on-demand."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "So, what are you waiting for? Head over to Amazon and sign up for Starz today. And if you're not a Prime member, consider joining to take advantage of this amazing deal. Happy streaming!"
